Built on results, rooted in trust

GK9 was founded on a simple belief: every dog deserves to reach its full potential, and every owner deserves a dog they can trust completely.

We specialize in obedience, behavior rehabilitation, and personal protection, working with all breeds and all temperaments. We build strong bonds between owners and dogs through discipline, structure, and proven methods.

Dog Selection & Evaluation

Find the right dog before making a lifelong commitment.

Choosing a dog based only on breed, appearance, or a short first impression can lead to a poor match. We help evaluate temperament, energy level, behavior, confidence, and overall compatibility with your lifestyle and goals.

Our service can include:

  • Understanding your lifestyle, experience, family environment, and goals
  • Recommending suitable breeds, types, ages, and temperaments
  • Helping search shelters, rescues, breeders, and available dogs
  • Reviewing potential dogs before scheduling a meeting
  • Attending meetings with the client when possible
  • Evaluating temperament, confidence, sociability, drive, and behavior
  • Identifying potential behavioral concerns or compatibility issues
  • Helping compare multiple dogs
  • Providing a professional assessment before the client makes a final decision
Custom Pricing

Disclaimer:Behavioral evaluations cannot guarantee a dog's future behavior or medical health. We recommend an independent veterinary examination before adoption or purchase.
